title: Air quality and traffic: can we explain poor-air days and warn clinic patients in time?
client: Valdena Civic Health Office (fictional, northern Italy)

windows.purpose: Build the method on public hourly air-quality readings while the city's own station data is requested.
Two years of the city's own station, traffic and clinic data for the live warning model.

needs.name: Hourly air-pollutant concentrations (for example NO2 or PM2.5)
Hourly vehicle traffic near the monitoring stations
Daily respiratory clinic visits, as counts by district
National yearly context: deaths linked to PM2.5

links_hint: The public hourly air-quality dataset is on the UCI repository. For national context, the Eurostat PM2.5 health indicator has a JSON-stat API. Check the city, the period and the missing-value coding before you accept a link.
